headline: Linn Mercy Works Shift; Cape and Expanse Guns Roar
war_summary: Fresh colours fly at Linn Mercy, where the Colonial tally has climbed to nine works against one Warden and one unclaimed, up from seven Colonial at the last edition. Mooring County likewise shows the Colonials at three works to the Wardens' nine, a gain of one since the previous report, though its guns have cooled to nothing in the past watch. At Callum's Cape the last unclaimed work has been taken up, leaving four Colonial to three Warden, while that front remains the war's busiest at forty-eight actions in the day and two in the past two hours. Weathered Expanse is the freshest of all, its latest action logged at this edition's cutoff; its works now read five Warden, two Colonial and two unclaimed, a Colonial gain. Marban Hollow holds at three works apiece with two unclaimed. Lykos Isle has fallen quiet after its brief stir, and Stonecradle, Nevish Line and Godcrofts remain silent, their last reports hours old.
